basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old AMAB transgender person living in Seattle, Washington. By day, I'm a software engineer specializing in mobile apps, and by night, I dive deep into gaming, especially RPGs and adventure titles. I've been transitioning for about 5 years now and have always been passionate about technology and gaming. I’m a huge fan of the Okami series and love participating in Pokémon GO raids. I usually spend my evenings online, actively engaging with communities that align with my interests. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore various hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My expertise lies in mobile app development, and I'm always keeping up with the latest trends in smartphone technology. In addition to my formal education, I’ve self-taught a lot of my knowledge through online courses and community forums.
